newsitem.title: USA: FBL Financial realized gains up in Q4.
newsitem.headline: FBL Financial realized gains up in Q4.

text.p: FBL Financial Group Inc, reporting improved fourth-quarter results, said realized gains on investments in the period increased $37.8 million to $36.8 million compared to a realized loss of $989,000 in the same 1995 period.
The increase resulted primarily from a $33.5 million gain on the sale of a significant portion of one equity investment.
The company's total assets at December 31 were $3.4 billion compared to $3.1 billion at yearend 1995.

Tom Gibson, chief executive officer, said the company's new incentive agent compensation program, introduction of a uniform portfolio of life and annuity products and more effective and increased training of its agency force all are expected to contribute to revenue growth in 1997.
FBL, an insurance holding company that went public in July 1996, reported fourth-quarter earnings of $37.9 million or $1.95 per share, up from $18.1 million or $0.76 per share.
